REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS

  400 W. Civic Center Drive

  audit and investigation of all contracts directed or influenced by former Supervisor Andrew

  management, and review current procurement and compliance policies and present findings
  and recommendations at a Board of Supervisors meeting or public forum; direct County

  whistleblowers, investigation of complaints, expanded anti-retaliation policy and training
  and awareness of new or expanded program; and direct Office of Campaign Finance and
  Ethics Commission to research industry best practices for implementation of an expanded
  Code of Ethics for Supervisors with potential enforcement mechanisms and provide
  recommendations to the Board for adoption
